facts.fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab page says Zanzibar is channelling data from vertical programme systems into the national HMIS (ZHMIS) through the Zanzibar Health Information Layer, led by the Ministry of Health Zanzibar, with a workshop validating end-to-end flows into ZHMIS.

note: No fact on in-service national coverage, linkage to named surveillance, supply-chain or immunisation systems, or reporting rate: the page states none of these.
